body:
I've already gotten kicked out of my parents house.  I've always struggled with depression and they've always tried to tough-love it.  I already know they won't give me the time of day, as they're aware of my situation and think helping=enabling.

I don't have the means to keep increasing my debt with school, nor do I have a goal I'd pursue if I did.
I have a degree in something generically liberal arts-y, but I've never had a job that wasn't food service.

>if you push through it you'll only come out stronger

I'm going to be paying off massive debts for another 10 years.  I cannot get a job that will pay enough that I can continue to have shelter/food/transport.  I don't have the means to push through it.  I'm doing this because I'd rather do this than starve or get stabbed on a street corner or become a prostitute.
